name: ZECON
recent: ZECON 于 2026 年 11 月 19 日召开特别股东大会，股东批准了以 RM54,360,000 向持股 51% 的子公司 ZECON SOLAR 转租砂拉越 Kuching 约 302 英亩土地（为期 30 年）的提案，以及设立最高占已发行股本 15% 的 ESOS。同期，董事 Datuk Zainal Abidin bin Ahmad 多次申报持股变动。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会批准 ZECON RENEWABLES (SARAWAK) 以 RM54,360,000 向 ZECON SOLAR 转租 Kuching 约 302 英亩土地，为期 30 年。
股东批准设立员工认股计划（ESOS），涉及发行最多占已发行股本 15% 的新股。
股东批准向包括 Tan Sri Datuk Amar Mohamad Morshidi bin Abdul Ghani、Datuk Haji Zainal Abidin bin Haji Ahmad 等董事分配 ESOS 期权。
risks: ESOS 最多可发行占已发行股本 15% 的新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
董事 Datuk Zainal Abidin bin Ahmad 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。

news.title: Zecon Medivest Issues RM655 Million AA2-Rated Sukuk to Refinance Zecon Medicare Debt
Zecon seeks nod for RM54.36m Kuching solar land sublease
Zecon proposes to sublease land for RM54.36 mil in related party deal

recent_en: ZECON held an EGM on 19 November 2026 where shareholders approved the RM54,360,000 sublease of about 302 acres of land in Kuching, Sarawak from its 51%-owned subsidiary ZECON SOLAR for a 30-year term, and the establishment of an ESOS of up to 15% of issued shares. Meanwhile, Director Datuk Zainal Abidin bin Ahmad filed several changes in his shareholding.
notable_en: Shareholders at the EGM approved the RM54,360,000 sublease of about 302 acres in Kuching by ZECON RENEWABLES (SARAWAK) from ZECON SOLAR for a 30-year term.
Shareholders approved the establishment of an ESOS involving the issuance of up to 15% of issued shares.
Shareholders approved the allocation of ESOS options to directors including Tan Sri Datuk Amar Mohamad Morshidi bin Abdul Ghani and Datuk Haji Zainal Abidin bin Haji Ahmad.
risks_en: The ESOS may issue new shares of up to 15% of issued share capital, potentially diluting existing shareholders.
Director Datuk Zainal Abidin bin Ahmad filed multiple changes in his shareholding between October and November 2026.
